recent_en: PBS Berhad has recently issued monthly announcements as a Paragraph/Rule 8.03A company and disclosed the intention of Director and President/CEO Loo Hooi Keat to deal in securities during the closed period. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 106.8% QoQ and net profit increased significantly YoY.
notable_en: Director and President/CEO Loo Hooi Keat indicated his intention to deal in the Company's securities during the closed period.
The Company continues to issue monthly announcements as a Paragraph/Rule 8.03A company.
risks_en: The Company is a Paragraph/Rule 8.03A company and is required to issue monthly announcements.
A Director indicated intention to deal in the Company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3,267,000, up 106.8% QoQ and 6.1% YoY; net income was MYR 25,075,000, up 459.3% YoY, with a net margin of 767.5%.
